type: Developer-run synthetic cases, one model response each; not user research or proof of reduced disputes.

cases.request: Design a two-sided cafe menu with revisions. Deliver print-ready files by Friday.
reviewFor: Print file specifications and printing responsibility
included: Design of two-sided cafe menu (front and back)
needs: Menu content (food and drink items, descriptions, prices)
Cafe branding assets (logo, colors, fonts) or direction to source them
Specifications for print-ready output (file format, resolution, color mode, trim/bleed settings)
Target Friday and timezone for deadline
Specific revision limit or revision process

questions.prompt: How many rounds of revisions are included? Are revisions unlimited, or is there a specific number or time limit?
Which Friday and what timezone? (This determines the exact deadline.)
What file format and specifications do you need? (For example: PDF with bleed marks, InDesign source file, resolution, CMYK or RGB color mode, trim size, etc.)

cases.request: Build a five-page website with a booking form and ongoing support.
reviewFor: Inquiry form versus live booking and availability
Duration and boundaries of ongoing support
included: Five-page website (pages and structure pending clarification)
Booking form (fields and functionality pending clarification)
Ongoing support (scope and duration pending clarification)
needs: Customer text content for all five pages, or confirmation that you will supply it
Logo and visual brand assets, or confirmation that design should be created from scratch
List of booking form fields required (e.g., name, email, date, time, service type, etc.)
Specification of file formats for final deliverable (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS, WordPress, static site generator)
Definition of 'ongoing support' scope and duration

questions.prompt: What are the five pages and their purposes? (e.g., Home, About, Services, Contact, Booking)
What information must the booking form collect, and what should happen after submission? (e.g., email confirmation, calendar sync, payment processing)
What does ongoing support include and for how long? (e.g., bug fixes for 6 months, content updates, performance monitoring, emergency availability)
Should the form integrate with a calendar, payment processor, or email service, or just collect and store data?
Will you provide all written content, images, and branding, or should these be created as part of this project?
